Sangma --- Page 4 --- Scrooge aro Christmasni Gisikrang C Brucellish K. Sangma.
First Edition: October, 2005. 1000 copies : 2005.
Price: Printed at Labanya Press, Guwahati-1. --- Page 5 --- cas boek beiungs to Govu AGANCHENGANI "Scrooge aro Christmasni Gisikrang" -ian pe-skagimin golposa.

Charles Dickensni segipa "A Christmas Carol" -ko Rani Sircar bi-sarangna poraitona gita altukale aro bakkandikkale aro katta bichongko on-tisa dingtangate, seskaaha. "Scrooge aro Christmasni Gisikrang" -ko ia seskagiminonikosa pe-skaa.
Charles Dickens 1812 oni 1870 ona janggi tanggipa, songsarni golporangko sena changbegipa British mande ong-achim.

Uni pagipa gro nangstipe pattoko dongani gimin, ua bilsi 12 onin karkanao kam ka-mitingo uni nie-nike uie-ma-sie ra-anirang uni golpo seanirangna namgipapangchakanikoon-aha. Uni seanirangoni mongsongbatgiparanga A Christmas Carol, David Copperfield, Oliver Twist, A Tale of Two Cities, Pickwick Papers aro Great Expectations.

A Christmas Carolara alaksibegipa akotibegipa mande Ebenezer Scroogeni aro Christmasni salsa skanggipa attamo uni me-mangrangko gisikrangko chagrongani golpo, jean bilsini bilsirangna dal-a chona a-gilsakni pilakkon gisik nangatan baksana kusi ong-atenga. Dickens ia golpoko 1843 bilsio seahaoba, uko 1915 bilsiosa chappa ka-atchengaha.
Manderang namnikbeani gimin, ia golpoko changni chang chappa ka-taitaikuaienga. Scrooge kattani ortoara alaksibegipa, akotibegipa.
Ebenezer alaksibeani gimin uko Scrooge minga ongja. Ebenezer Scrooge alaksibegipa mande ong-ani giminsa, alaksibegipa manderangna uni bimingko jakkala.
Indake English katta "Scrooge" Charles Dickensni golpoo mongsonggipa bakko ragipa Scrooge-onisa ong.kata.
Ku-sik mingsao segiminko ku-gipinona pe-skaaniara altugipa kam ong.ja. Je ku-siko seachim, ua ku-sikko ui-ma-simangmangaioba chu'ongja.

Seanio jatni-manderangni dakbewal-rikbewal- aganbewalrang napchipile donga; uarangko taljaode, pe-sretanichi ma·sisretaniarodilsretaniona soka. Kattarangni ortorang rokomgni ong-na man-a: kosakgilgilgipa orto miksonga, pe-skagipa uko name ma.sie ra.chengna ga-aka.

Semanchagipa uni jatni-manderangni dakbewal-rikbewalko ja-rike, badiaba gadangni manderangni aganako baibai rakkie, kra-nitogija aro ku-attogija kattarangko seanio jakkalnaba donga. Badiaba gipin jatni dakbewal- rikbewalode ku-attogija kattarangkc jinmaode aro seaniode jakkalrongjani gimin aro uarangko manderang ra-chakjawani gimin, (iii) --- Page 6 --- ua kattarangko tiktak pe-skagija donmitapa kattarangchi seskana draatako man-a.
Ku-gipinni kattarangna basakobade ku-tango orto apsangipa kattarangko man-ja. Indake ong-on, apsananggipa kattarangko ba adita kattarangko dondime talatgipakosa jakkalna ga-aka.

Tangkana katta jakkalaba dingtangronga aro mitam obostarang aro bosturangde pe-skaenggipani samtangtango aro ku-siko dongjanaba donga. Unon pe-skaenggipa ku-tango dongipa gipin apsananggipa kattarangko aro uni samtangtango donggipa bosturangni bimingrangko on·skaa.
Pe-skagimin seani, dongbringipa songsaro, pe-skaenggipani ku-siko sea-jotanirangni gisepo ra.chakako man-na nanggen.
Un baksanaba, ua seani 'individuality' ba uni dingtangmancha ong aniko gimaatna nangjawa. Sechenggipa golponi gun aro su-uanikoba peskaanio jaktuatjana jott on ka-anikoba nangchongmota.
Ia pilakko nigopesa, pe-skagipa kattarangni ortoko pe-a aro ku-gipino donskaa. Indake pe-skaaniara, segital-rugitalani gunkoba parakani ong-a.

A-gilsak da-o chonrikrikangenga. Re-a-doani aro ku-agangrikani, kobor watgrikani cholrang nambatbeaha aro tang.dobeahani gimin, meli-nangrime, sambabatgrike janggi tangania, ku-sik man'grikgijanichi peng:panganiko ra-galna nanganiko ong-katata.
Namgipa chugipa gadango seanirangko ku'gipino pe-skaaniba, ia peng-panganiko ragalani chol mingsa onga. Namgipa seaniko poraigakmanode, uko gipinrangna rengsi tikatna skani bang-a manderangon gnang.
Indaka gisikan angkoba ia golpoko pe-skae dal-giminrangona aro chongiparangonaba sokatna skataha.

Poraigiparangko suk ong-atjana ba gisik dongtoatjanade iako seja, indiba uamangni gisiko maiba chanchianiko nakatatnasa sea, ine Dickens uni Aganchenganio janapa. Golpo nambeani gisik gisikko, Dickensni miksonga gitan, su-dikchongmota.
An·tangtangni gisikni re-aniko aro janggi tanganiko nipilatnaba ia golpo uko poraigiparangna do-ga oe on-a. Brucellish K.
Sangma Tura Hawakhana. (Renangma) (iv) --- Page 7 --- SCROOGE ARO CHRISTMASNI GISIKRANG (Charles Dickensni segipa “"A Christmas Carol"-ko Rani Sircar kan-dikkale altukale seskaaha.

Ia seskagiminkosa A-chikkuona pe-skaaha.) MARLEYNI ME-MANG Uan Christmasna salsagipani attamchim aro ua attamara sin-begipa attam ongachim. Sinbea aro guurirara, ka-sinbegipa ka-namgijagipa balwani balara manderangni mikkangrango su-a gita nangchakachim aro grengrangko tin-kaata gita dakpilachim.

Salgimikan sal ontisamangba najachim aro da-o, songjinmani ghori dal-giparang gittam bajikosan dokataiengkuoba, andalgopaiahachim. Officerango aro dokanrango bijoli chingataha aro sorokni teng-atanirangkoba teng-ataha.
Indiba guuri mitmatdugaani gimin teng-ata teng-atja gita dakaiaha; batesa samtangtangni andalaniko andaldapataha.
Pilakchin guuri, a-paloba aro nokningoba. Indiba guurioba, singekgekoba aro balwa ka-namjaoba, Christmas Eve-de Christmas Eve.

Manderang kamtangtangko dakmitingo gisik ritchengachim aro kusi ong-achim, aro dokanrangba bang-en palnangaha. Kusi ong-ani salko manina gita boksisrangko brena nangachim aro cha-ani, ringanirang aro rokomari bosturang manderangna brena nanggiparang bang-achim.

Wil-wat pil-pat mande gapao, saksa sakgipinko grongdike me-a me-chikrang “Merry Christmas, Mery Christmas" ine salam ka-griktokaha. Banoba banoba, sorok teng-atgipani ja-pangrango ba dokan cholgugarango chadengsroke, salgipino cha-nasienggipa Christmasni meatamni gimin chanchijoljole, bi-sarang Christmasni gitrangko ring-engachim.

Indioba, galsrua gita dakgipa office ge-sao, High Streetni sambamangmango, Christmasnade adita kantarangsanjok ine --- Page 8 --- mesokna maming chinan dongjachim. Ianode ua salni guuri aro sin-aniara, ningtukalgipa dringo tableni samsachi asongenggipa, katong rakgipa, ka-sachakani grigipa mandeni simgropgipa gisik ka-tongming tik meliachim.
Uni bimingara Ebenezer Scrooge; aro a-palo, office doga kosako, 'Scrooge aro Marley' ine rongchi see dona dongachim.

Maina Scrooge aro Marleyara bang-a bilsirangna tangka dakani karbaro bakrimgiparang ong-achim; aro Marley bilsi snina skangan siangahaoba, uni bimingko ra-galna Scrooge simsakjaha. Ruuta somoinan Scrooge aro Marley maikai tangka aro uamang tangka man-ba man-roroaha.
Tangka. Tangka.
Tangka. Uan uamangni janggi tangani, chu-gimik janggi tangani.
Uamangni gamna rikaniko mamingchiba aro darangkoba pengpangna on.jaha. Aro da-o, ia bilsi snina Marley siahaoba, Scrooge apsankon dakangkuaha.
Tangka: uko maidake man-gen, aro uko maidake bangdaproroatgen, uarangsan uni janggi tanganio gisik nanganirang. Ua maming saloba tangkachi brena mangipa bosturango kusi ong.jaha.
Gelna man-ode ua tangkako maming saloba koros ka-jaha, aro ka-telna ga-akode, on-matgijasa aro gisik suk ong-gijasa.
Ua darangnaba indin ka-saede on.jaha. Uni ning-o kerani kagipa kangalbegipa Bob Cratchitko dugapile kam ka-ateba on-aniode komiskabeachim.

Uni gimin, ia ka-namgijagipa, alaksibegipa mandeo ripengska donggijaniara aiao inmanani ongja. Uni ka.namgijaniko uni mikkango nikpilaiani gimin re-pakgiparangba uko re-gelachim aro bi-sarangba ramarango uchikode niatmangjachim.
Scrooge una simba simsakjachim. Indakarangkoba uade nikskajachim; ua an-tangni jaksramgijani kamrango jakchakgija ong-e dongaiachim.

Indake, gisiktango Christmasni an-saoanina on-tisaba chanchiani gri, ia sin-begipa guuriarigipa attamo, Scrooge chokkio asongari tangkani bohirango aro hisabrango jakchakgija ong-e dongaiaha. Mikkiari on·tisamangmang wa-al so.pagiparang ching-rakjaen uko on-tisaba ding-atjachim.
Uni ka-namgija ka-tong ua sin-begipa dringon haida katchaakon.

--- Page 9 --- Oe dongenggipa doga gita ua a-palchipakgipa dringkoba nirokatjolaha, jeon duk man-beenggipa kerani, sin.dugae chiktotgimin jaksirangchi kam ka-na jotton ka-e, stool-o kom-tote asongengachim. Gitik gitak office do-ga oprakbaaha aro ka-srokgipa ku-rang gam-baaha: 'Merry Christmas, Mama: Namengama?' Uan Scroogeni gritang, uni sianggimin nogipani saksa kam-kam depante; mikkang rongchinga, chananga aro gisik kusin gapa.
'Ichi uchiba ong-gijagipa' ine Scrooge inaha. Gokani kam!' 'Maiko indina, Mama?' ine Fred, uni grigipa singaha.
'Christmasara maikai gokani kam onggen?' ‘Merry Christmas chong.motde uara: Gokani kam! Chu-gimikan gokani kam!

ine Scrooge aganchakaha. 'Indita kangal ong-ora nang-ni Christmasara maikai kusi onggipa, katchaatgipa Christmas ong-gen?' 'Indiba na-ade mane cha-aba, Mama, aro anga uichcjmota, na-ade kusi ong-gipa, katchagipa Christmasko rianlla amgen,' ine kusi ongkue, katchakue, Fred aganarigkuaha.
Scrooge, 'Gokani kam' inemangmangsan agantaiaiaha. Maibakae ua katta uni namnikbatsranggipa katta ong-baaha, maina ua uko baditaba chang agantaikuaha.
'Christmasara choligijagipa, lap grigipa somoi, ine Scrooge aganangkuaha, je somoion mande an·tango dongana bate koros ka-a; aro bangki jachisako una ka-pak sintipile re-ata.
Unikode apsankon daktaipilaia! Christmasara darangnaba namgniko dakkuja.
Christmasko nang-ni ska gita jedakeba maniaibo. Anga nang-ko champengna man.ja.
Indiba Christmasko angni ska gita manina angna on-bo.' Indiba na-ade manian manijake!' ine Fred aiao inmane aganaha. 'Indide angko saksan ong-na on.bo', Scrooge inaha.
'Nang-na namgniko dakbejokde uara. Bang-a namgniko --- Page 10 --- dakkugen ua nang-na!
Fred inaha, 'Christmasko angade namgipa somoi inesa chanchironga.
Gisik namani, ka-saani aro on-ani somoi. Changsa somoi, jeon pilak manderangan, gipin somoirango uamang jedakgipa manderang onggenchimoba, gisik sontolkala, ka-sachakbatkala.

Indakgipa somoi, jeon manderang niri-gisianirangko guala aro uamang saksa sakgipinni ripengrang ine gisik ra-a aro saksa sakgipinko kema kaa. Uni gimin Mama, Christmas angko pelsachimangba man-e cha-dapatkujaoba, ua angna namgniko dakmanaha aro dakkugen ine anga bebera-a.

Christmasna Nokgipa pattichina!' A-palchipakgipa dringo dongenggipa mangchongipa kerani chanchisrapgijan jakpa dokataha, aro songsaro uni biapko gisik ra-pile, sko dengnokgalgale, wa-al su-rokrokatoa, wa-alan sisrangaha. 'Simsakjaode Christmasko janggi tangani kam grisa manina nanggenne,' ine Scrooge kenenggipa Bob Cratchitna inataha.
Aro na-a, anggri, parliamentna chakatsrangbo. Na-a katta agannade changa.' 'Ka-anangpanabe, Mama.
Re-baenba knalo ching baksa cha-pabo. Unasa angade re.baade re-baachim, nang.ko okamnasa,' Fred inaha.
'Nang.ming chapana, anggri?
Na-a sko tik ongjakon. Nang siakon anga nikchenggen, ine Scrooge chrikdataha.
'Maini gimin?' ine Fred aiao inmanbee sing-aha. ‘Na-ara maina bia kagalgala?' ine Scrooge singaha.

Fredni aganchakaniara, Ka-saa napani gimin.' ‘Ka-saa napani gimin!' ine Scrooge chrikdattaiaha. 'Good Afternoon.' 'Indiba na-ara angni pantemitingomangba angko nina re-bajake; da-ora maina angni bia ka-aniko nang-ni re-gijani a-sel dake on-engjok?' ine Fred sing·taikuaiaha.
'Good Afternoon,'ine Scrooge indattaiaha.'Na-a indita gisik namjaengana anga duk ong-a, Mama. Anga nang-oniko mamingkoba nangja.
An.chingni ripeng ong.grikanikosan anga
